features.description: SequentialAgent factory wiring — add agent_type field to SkillMetadata, branch create_agent on agent_type, implement intake_gate before_agent_callback and final_progress after_agent_callback
acceptance_criteria: SkillMetadata.agent_type defaults to 'llm' and round-trips through Firestore via agentType camelCase alias
create_agent returns SequentialAgent instance when md.agent_type=='sequential' with correct sub_agents list
Existing LlmAgent skills (no agent_type field) still build as LlmAgent — zero regression
intake_gate before_agent_callback returns types.Content with 'please upload an invoice' message when session state lacks documents
intake_gate returns None when session state has documents loaded (no-op path)
final_progress after_agent_callback emits a STAGE_PROGRESS event via the existing LatencyTracker
Unit tests pass: test_skill_metadata.py::test_agent_type_defaults_to_llm, ::test_agent_type_sequential_round_trips
Unit tests pass: test_agent_factory.py::test_sequential_agent_built_for_pipeline, ::test_intake_gate_returns_friendly_content_when_no_document, ::test_intake_gate_no_op_when_document_present

acceptance_criteria: New file backend/skills/templates/ap-pipeline/SKILL.md exists with agent_type: sequential and subSkills: [invoice-extractor, ap-validator, ap-poster]
ap-orchestrator/SKILL.md subSkills changed to [ap-pipeline]; Invoice Review Card JSON block removed; instruction rewritten to 'transfer once or chat'

ap-poster/SKILL.md instruction directs the model to read session state (verdict + extracted_invoice), invoke post_to_ledger or route_to_approval, then emit the Invoice Review Card via send_a2ui_json_to_client

ap-validator/SKILL.md gains a per-specialist updateComponents block appending a 'validation_section' Column with check ticks, plus vendor-master in tool_configs.mcp_servers
platform_seed.py iterates the new ap-pipeline template directory and creates a Firestore skill record with agent_type=sequential

features.description: Simulated FastMCP servers for vendor-master + erp-posting, mounted into FastAPI alongside the existing /mcp server, with Firestore seed entries and per-tool tests
acceptance_criteria: vendor_master_mcp FastMCP server exposes lookup_vendor(name) and check_duplicate(invoice_number, vendor_id) tools
lookup_vendor returns {found: True, vendor_id, country, payment_terms, kyc_status} for 5-8 synthetic vendors covering the demo invoices; {found: False} for unknowns
check_duplicate returns {duplicate: bool, posted_at, posting_id} based on a synthetic posting history
erp_posting_mcp FastMCP server exposes post_to_ledger(invoice, gl_code, posting_period) and route_to_approval(invoice, reasons) tools
post_to_ledger returns {posting_id, posted_at (ISO8601), gl_account, status: 'POSTED'}
route_to_approval returns {ticket_id, queue: 'finance', sla_hours: 24}
Both servers mounted into fast_api_app.py at /mcp/vendor-master and /mcp/erp-posting
seed_mcp_servers.py creates Firestore entries mcp_servers/vendor-master and mcp_servers/erp-posting pointing at the live URLs
ap-validator/SKILL.md references vendor-master in tool_configs.mcp_servers
ap-poster/SKILL.md references erp-posting in tool_configs.mcp_servers
Tool tests pass: test_vendor_master_mcp.py (3 tests), test_erp_posting_mcp.py (2 tests) — all using FastMCP in-process test client
